title: Honeypots
intro: Bait paths that no legitimate user ever requests. A hit pins the scanner's connection in a slow-drip tarpit and bumps its threat score. Toggle each pack globally or override per virtual host.
restart.title: Restart required.
restart.body: One or more settings were saved to the runtime configuration. Run
llm.title: LLM HONEYPOT
llm.description: Serves convincing AI-generated fake content to scanners that probe known AI-related paths. Keeps crawlers engaged while the tarpit accumulates their threat score. Requires a service restart to activate — this is a startup configuration flag.
llm.note: Saving this toggle updates the runtime configuration and requires a service restart to take effect.
tarpit.title: TARPIT SETTINGS
tarpit.description: Tune the slow-drip response shape and the automatic firewall-block threshold.
tarpit.master: Master switch — disables all honeypot matching when off
packs.title: BUILT-IN PACKS ({{count}})
packs.description: Disable a pack if you legitimately run the matching software on every host. For site-by-site control, use per-host overrides below.
perHost.title: PER-HOST OVERRIDES
perHost.description: Disable a specific pack for a specific virtual host without affecting the global default. Use when only one site behind this proxy actually runs the matching software.
perHost.empty: No overrides — all hosts use the global pack selection above.
perHost.removeAll: Remove all overrides for this host
trusted.title: TRUSTED OPERATOR SITES
trusted.descPrefix: Hosts listed here are completely exempt from honeypot matching. Use this for your own WordPress or legacy sites that legitimately serve paths the built-in packs would flag (e.g.
trusted.empty: No trusted sites — honeypot matching applies to all hosts.
trusted.reEnable: Re-enable honeypot matching for this host

custom.ariaLabel: Custom honeypot probe paths, one per line
